kilavuz.connect: In veterinary mode the PEMF hardware must be on the SAME Wi-Fi network as your computer. The app finds it automatically; if not, enter the device IP manually in the app's Settings.
kilavuz.intro: PEMF Vet is a platform for AI-assisted diagnosis and PEMF (pulsed magnetic field) sessions in cats. This client downloads, installs and starts the app on your computer. The steps below are written for someone with no prior experience — just follow them in order.
kilavuz.profTitle: 3 Profiles — which one is for you?

p01.does: Runs AI pre-diagnosis from your cat's camera image: disease, organ, imaging and sound analysis. Does NOT include a device or session.

use.u01: When the app opens, choose ‘Pet Owner’ and sign in.
use.u03: Point your camera at the cat or upload a photo/sound file.
use.u04: Read the result and suggestions — always consult a veterinarian for a definitive diagnosis.

p02.does: Diagnosis + PEMF device sessions + patient records, session history, sensor tracking, KPI panel and simulator. Also includes the Pet Owner diagnostic models (hence the larger size).

use.u03: Start a session from ‘Control’; adjust coils manually or run autonomously with ‘AI Pro’.
use.u04: Track the session via ‘Sensors’ and ‘History’; see clinic stats in ‘KPI’.

p03.does: Petri, histopathology, kidney and phantom AI models; sample/data records and history. Does NOT include a device.

use.u02: Pick the relevant research model from ‘Smart Diagnosis’.
use.u03: Upload your image or data file.
use.u04: Review the results and save them to ‘History’.

s01.b: The 'Main application' card at the top is part of every installation and cannot be removed (interface and shared models; its size is shown on the right, or 'installed' if already present). Tick at least one of the 3 profiles below it (Pet Owner, Veterinarian, Research). You can pick several; each card shows ONLY its own download size, and the button total counts only what will actually download (the main application if not yet installed + your new picks). In 'Change profiles', an already installed profile says 'installed' and is not counted; unticking an installed profile marks it 'will be removed' and it is deleted from this computer when you press the button.

s02.b: Your selected models download and install. The bar shows percent, speed (MB/s) and time left. You can Pause or Cancel anytime; even if the internet drops or the computer shuts down, you can resume where you left off when you reopen.

s03.b: When installation finishes, the app opens in your browser. Next time, use the ‘Start’ button in this window to open it in seconds.

k01.b: Click ‘Repair’ in this window — it re-verifies the packages and fills in what's missing.
k01.t: The app won't open or a model is missing

k02.b: Reopen the app; answer ‘Resume where you left off?’ with ‘Resume’. The downloaded part is kept.

k03.b: Click ‘Uninstall’ (your patient data is KEPT), then install again.
k03.t: I want to reinstall from scratch

k04.b: Use the ‘Website’ link at the top or ‘Support’ at the bottom.
